marks.label: Smokey Bear
marks.title: The Forest Service creates Smokey Bear after Disney's one-year loan of Bambi runs out
marks.sentence: However, Bambi was only loaned to the government for a year, so after that the Forest Service needed a new symbol.

marks.label: Sega merger off
marks.title: The planned Sega and Bandai merger falls through
marks.sentence: However, the major success of Bandai's Tamagotchi toy line, which also launched the previous year, and strong opposition from within Bandai caused the plan to fall through.
marks.note: The record names the toy's success and opposition inside Bandai.

marks.label: Carnival buys Cunard
marks.title: Carnival acquires the Cunard Line
marks.sentence: Coincidently, it was the same percentage that Cunard owned in Cunard-White Star Line and the company historian later stated the acquisition was in-part due to the success of James Cameron's blockbuster 1997 film, Titanic.

marks.sentence: In 1976, the studio was renamed from EMI to Abbey Road after the band's 1969 album.

marks.label: Born This Way Foundation
marks.title: The Born This Way Foundation for young people's wellness is founded
marks.sentence: Named after the singer's 2011 album Born This Way, and the song from the album with the same name, the foundation is committed to supporting the wellness of young people and working with them to "make the world kinder and braver".

marks.label: Falkirk Center
marks.title: Liberty University names its Falkirk Center partly after the film
marks.sentence: The name was derived, in part, from the portmanteau combining the names of Jerry Falwell Jr. and Charlie Kirk, as well as Falwell's affinity for the film Braveheart and the Battle of Falkirk, which was depicted in the film.
